meta.title: Find in conversations
meta.description: Ctrl+F searches every workspace and conversation locally, showing reasoning and conversation text in separate panes, then jumps to the matching paragraph.

label.title: Find in conversations
label.empty: Type text, then press Enter or click Find.
label.ready: Press Enter or click Find to search.
label.hideArchivedHint: Leave hits from archived conversations out of the panes
label.noResultsHidden: Nothing to show: {count} more match(es) sit in archived conversations, which you chose to hide
label.truncated: Too many results, showing the first {count}
label.hint: Enter or Find to search · click a result to jump · Esc close
label.speakerFiltered: Nothing to show: {count} hit(s) hidden by the source filter
